title: Basilica of Saint Nicholas
visualBrief: Individual Basilica of Saint Nicholas in Bari: unequal flat-topped western towers, pale stone central gable and sloped shoulders, triple western portals with gabled central prothyron, small round/paired windows and oculus, deep lower round side arcades and grouped upper galleries, high eastern transept and flat rectangular eastern wall with large framed barred window. Four budgeted browser tiers; shared cream ashlar/limestone, muted terracotta tile and plain wood. Metric UVs/linear tints, no embedded images. Standard terrain foundations. Exact reliefs/statues/inscriptions, carved tracery, small liturgical fittings, interiors, adjacent old-town fabric, parking/railings, surveyed paving/steps and walking excluded.

All vertical dimensions are explicit picture estimates: nave eave25m/ridge29.8m, side gallery wall20.5m/roof join24m, east transept eave24m/ridge29m, north tower18.8m and south tower27.5m.
